statement: Convert tabular data between delimited text and in-memory data tables by formatting lists into CSV text and parsing CSV text back into structured values.
superiority: Dino 8 should parse CSV with explicit delimiter, quoting and encoding handling and report row-level errors instead of failing on a bad cell.

acceptance.corpus: RFC 4180 conformance samples incl. quoted commas, embedded newlines, UTF-8 BOM
acceptance.tolerance: Round trip parse(format(x)) equals x exactly for 100% of 200 rows
Bad rows reported with row index; good rows still parsed

statement: Build typed data tables and combine them into a dataset so definition results can be organized as named tables with headers and column types.
superiority: Dino 8 should keep tables as first-class typed objects with schema validation, so float, integer and null inputs never corrupt the table (a failure users report in the original).

acceptance.corpus: Table with integer, float, text, boolean and null columns, 50 000 rows
acceptance.tolerance: Cell types preserved exactly; float and integer inputs both accepted without error

statement: Write a dataset out to an Excel workbook with one sheet per table, and read workbook sheets back into the definition with explicit read and write toggles.

statement: Read and write plain text files from a definition with toggles that control when disk access happens.

acceptance.corpus: Write 10 MB text then kill the process mid-write
acceptance.tolerance: Target file is either old or new content, never truncated (atomic replace)
